title: About Form 5471, Information Return of U.S. Persons With Respect To Certain Foreign Corporations | Internal Revenue Service
text: Skip to main content About Form 5471, Information Return of U.S. Persons With Respect To Certain Foreign Corporations More In Forms and Instructions Current year Prior year Accessible eBooks Browser-friendly forms and publications Mobile-friendly forms Post release changes to forms Order forms and publications Help with forms and instructions Comment on tax forms and publications Certain U.S. citizens and residents who are officers, directors, or shareholders in certain foreign corporations file Form 5471 and schedules to satisfy the reporting requirements of sections 6038 and 6046, and the related regulations. Current revision Form 5471 PDF Instructions for Form 5471 ( Print version PDF ) Recent developments Implementation of new foreign tax allocation reporting in Schedule E (Form 5471) instructions -- SEP-14-2026 Schedules Schedule E (Form 5471), Income, War Profits, and Excess Profits Taxes Paid or Accrued Foreign corporation’s that file Form 5471 use this schedule, to report taxes paid, accrued, or deemed paid and to report taxes for which a credit may not be taken. Schedule E (Form 5471) PDF Instructions for Schedule E (Form 5471) (Print version) PDF Schedule G-1 (Form 5471), Income, War Profits, and Excess Profits Taxes Paid or Accrued Foreign corporation’s that file Form 5471 use this schedule to report for each cost sharing arrangement in which the foreign corporation was a controlled during the tax year. Schedule G-1 (Form 5471) PDF Instructions for Schedule G-1 (Form 5471) (Print version) PDF Schedule H (Form 5471), Current Earnings and Profits Foreign corporation’s that file Form 5471 use this schedule to report the current E&P for U.S. tax purposes. Schedule H (Form 5471) PDF Instructions for Schedule H (Form 5471) (Print version) PDF Schedule H-1 (Form 5471), Pro Rata Share of CFC Adjusted Net Income or Loss for Corporate Alternative Minimum Tax. Applicable corporations filing Form 5471 use this schedule to report a CFC's adjusted net income or loss for Corporate Alternative Minimum Tax purposes. Schedule H-1 (Form 5471) PDF Instructions for Schedule H-1 (Form 5471) (Print version) PDF Schedule I-1 (Form 5471), Information for Global Intangible Low-Taxed Income Foreign corporation’s that file Form 5471 use this schedule to report information determined at the CFC level with respect to amounts used in the determination of income inclusions by U.S. shareholders. Schedule I-1 (Form 5471) PDF Instructions for Schedule I-1 (Form 5471) (Print version) PDF Schedule J (Form 5471), Accumulated Earnings & Profits (E&P) of Controlled Foreign Corporation Foreign corporation’s that file Form 5471 use this schedule to report a CFC’s accumulated E&P in its functional currency. Schedule J (Form 5471) PDF Instructions for Schedule J (Form 5471) (Print version) PDF Schedule M (Form 5471), Transactions Between Controlled Foreign Corporation and Shareholders or Other Related Persons Foreign corporation’s that file Form 5471 use this schedule to report the transactions that occurred during the foreign corporation's annual accounting period ending with or within the U.S. person's tax year. Schedule M (Form 5471) PDF Instructions for Schedule M (Form 5471) (Print version) PDF Schedule O (Form 5471), Organization or Reorganization of Foreign Corporation, and Acquisitions and Dispositions of its Stock Foreign corporation’s that file Form 5471 use this schedule to report the organization or reorganization of a foreign corporation and the acquisition or disposition of its stock. Schedule O (Form 5471) PDF Instructions for Schedule O (Form 5471) (Print version) PDF Schedule P (Form 5471), Previously Taxed Earnings and Profits of U.S. Shareholder of Certain Foreign Corporations Foreign corporation’s that file Form 5471 use this schedule to report the PTEP in the U.S. shareholder’s annual PTEP accounts. Schedule P (Form 5471) PDF Instructions for Schedule P (Form 5471) (Print version) PDF Schedule Q (Form 5471), CFC Income by CFC Income Groups Foreign corporation’s that file Form 5471 use this schedule to report the CFC’s income, deductions, taxes, and assets by CFC income groups. Schedule Q (Form 5471) PDF Instructions for Schedule Q (Form 5471) (Print version) PDF Schedule R (Form 5471), Distributions From a Foreign Corporation Foreign corporation’s that file Form 5471 use this schedule to report basic information pertaining to distributions from foreign corporations.
